results.name: no preset collides with itself, and every browser-reserved chord ships with the reason it is reserved
the format registry is a usable contract: engine, grade, boundary and a conversion-loss answer for every entry
SRT becomes WebVTT the way a browser needs it, and WebVTT is left alone
an .ics round-trips and re-importing the same calendar never duplicates
the new-device checklist is a real diff of two measured reports, and absent memory data is not low memory
every write is journalled and nothing is silently mutated: a read leaves no trace, a write leaves an auditable one
reversible by default: a trashed file comes back, and a changed setting can be put back from its own history
workspace presets are stored as their own rows and restoring one does not invent a viewport
notes are indexed in the same index as files, so one search reaches both
long operations are recorded as steps that can be polled, and every one ends in a terminal state
the capability report is exportable and redacted: it describes the browser, not the person
